links.outcome: Top-3 recall of physicians with versus without PhenoBrain assistance on 75 cases
links.effect: Combining PhenoBrain's predictions with specialists increased top-3 recall to 0.768, versus PhenoBrain alone 0.613 and specialists lower.
links.quote: Combining PhenoBrain's predictions with specialists increased the top-3 recall to 0.768, demonstrating its potential to enhance diagnostic accuracy in clinical workflows.

links.outcome: Top-3 and top-10 recall of AI versus specialist physicians, LLMs, and 13 prediction methods
links.effect: Top-3 recall 0.613 and top-10 recall 0.813 in 75 cases, surpassing 50 specialists, ChatGPT and GPT-4; 0.513/0.654 in 1936 test cases surpassing 13 methods.
links.quote: In a human-computer study with 75 cases, PhenoBrain exhibited exceptional performance with a top-3 recall of 0.613 and a top-10 recall of 0.813, surpassing the performance of 50 specialist physicians and large language models like ChatGPT and GPT-4.

screen.reason: Evaluates an AI diagnostic pipeline against clinicians and LLMs, including testing the impact of combining AI predictions with human specialist review on diagnostic accuracy.

primary.practice: combining AI predictions with clinician evaluation
